aiResearchSummary.text: CYGNVS is researching systems and methods for providing continuous cybersecurity readiness using adversary AI agents that generate customized threat scenarios and digital collaboration rooms. It is also developing systems and methods for facilitating tabletop exercises using collaboration environments, systems for securely tracking incident data and automatically generating data incident reports, and systems and methods for providing secure access to collaboration rooms with dynamic tenancy. Together these efforts focus on cyber crisis simulation, response management, and secure collaboration.
